أَلُوبٌ : see أَلْبٌ. ―
-b2- Also One who hastens, or is quick; (T;) and ↓ مِئْلَبٌ likewise signifies [the same; or] quick, or swift: (Ibn-Buzurj, T, K:) or the former signifies quick in drawing forth the bucket: (IAar, M, K:) or brisk, lively, sprightly, active, agile, or prompt, and quick; (K, TA;)
applied to a man. (TA.) ―
-b3- رِيْحٌ أَلُوبٌ A cold wind, (M,) that raises and scatters the dust. (M, K.) ―
-b4- سَمَآءٌ أَلُوبٌ A sky raining with long continuance. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
